description: This file defines a React functional component called HabitCard, which visually represents a habit with interactive elements such as toggles for recent days, streak info, sparkline trend, and delete functionality. It imports several utility functions and types to manage habit data and display logic.

methods.name: HabitCard
methods.description: React component that displays a habit with toggle buttons for the last 7 days, streak info, sparkline trend, and delete button. Handles state for interaction and calls external APIs for data updates.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Function to toggle habit completion status for a given day, updates working state, and calls onChanged callback upon success.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Function to delete the habit after confirmation, manages working state, and triggers onChanged callback.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Utility to check if a given date string is today's date.
